Marissa / Rachel / Neha —

Recommended approach from Sales Ops/legal POV:

1) Offer both representations in the commercial packet: a) a marginal ladder table (explicit breakpoints and per-token discount per tier) and b) a blended "effective rate" example for key volumes (1B and 3B). That satisfies finance and procurement.

2) Contract language: state that committed volume is measured against billable tokens net of trial credits and platform credits. Trial credits are treated as one-time promotional credits and do not count toward the committed minimum for the first 30 days; beyond that, any consumed tokens are counted. This avoids customers using credits to game the commit.

3) Soft-commit clause: allow a 3-month ramp with a "good-faith" soft-commit that becomes firm on month 4 if usage >= 90% of committed tier for two consecutive months. If they don't convert, standard overage rates apply (marginal ladder).

4) Pricing math example: (included inline so you can paste into the reply)
- Marginal ladder: 0–500M @ $0.000012/token; 500M–2B @ $0.0000095/token; >2B @ $0.000007/token.
- Blended price calculation at 1B: (500M * 0.000012 + 500M * 0.0000095) / 1B = $0.00001075/token.
- Blended price at 3B: (500M * 0.000012 + 1.5B * 0.0000095 + 1B * 0.000007) / 3B = $0.00000883/token (approx).

These numbers are placeholders; Sales can tilt margins by ~5–10% depending on the commit length.

Let me know if you want me to draft the paragraph for the SOW and the short bullet for procurement.
